name: Corpse Cannibal
body:
Drawbacks
Corpse Cannibal
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 64
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Urgathoa
Your faith encourages you to indulge a variety of perverse hungers, leading you to shrug at even some of the darkest taboos. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Fortitude saves against diseases and can gain sustenance from rotting flesh with no negative side effects.
